claim.operational_target: Given one person's confirmed, attributable response events plus current and prior conversation context, return one deterministic multi-head distribution, evidence-ranked content candidates, applicability status, refusal reasons, and a frozen rendering contract without a generative language-model call in the content path.
non_claims: confirmed accuracy for any real person's future response
recovery of beliefs, values, personality, emotion, or causal psychology
calibrated confidence before independent temporal validation
proof that weak rule labels are true semantic labels
proof that the available evidence corpus is complete
alternatives: a person-history frequency baseline performs equally well
a wrong-person or pooled population model performs equally well
claim.refusal_state: prediction_refused_when_evidence_or_local_support_is_insufficient; temporal staleness remains unimplemented for the response-event kernel
claim.scope: Confirmed direct-person text response events in the recorded language, time, domain, speaker, and context envelope; model-generated chat history is context only and never evidence.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: Strict later-time holdouts and the same questions scored by the correct-person, wrong-person, population, retrieval, history-frequency, and recent-population baselines.
unidentified_questions: whether selected evidence units reflect the person's current unobserved internal state
whether unobserved sources would change the fitted response distribution
whether apparent person specificity transfers beyond validated domains and times

evidence.completeness_boundary: The system can bind supplied source bytes, attribution, role, extraction, timestamps, near-duplicates, model versions, and prediction inputs. Only an external collection registry can establish corpus completeness and historical truth.

computation.uncertainty_scope: Head parameter uncertainty and local evidence support are reported; model-form, weak-label, corpus-completeness, and selection uncertainty remain unquantified, so confidence is explicitly uncalibrated.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_response_prediction_v1.py -v

results.summary: 337 full-regression tests passed after prediction-layer Loop 5 in 197.485 seconds

verification.browser_acceptance: Created two isolated people, processed raw Q&A, ran multi-turn prediction, proved zero reality calls while unchecked, compared a local reality answer without replacement, created a pending candidate, created v2, rolled back to v1, archived/restored a person, and retained state after restart.

remaining_limitations: No independent real-person temporal holdout is available in the local project.
Weak deterministic labels do not identify psychological constructs.
Name-only network collection requires a configured search provider.
Dynamic, mechanism, Empirical-Bayes, HyperNetwork, and cognitive feature candidates remain inactive until compatible response-event evidence and common evaluation exist.
Missing response time now blocks training, temporal validation, and reality optimization; runtime temporal expiry and independently verified occasion/relationship metadata remain incomplete.
